desc: Derive the structural reduction: degree-4 vertices of any alkane form a connected subtree S inside the forest of original vertices with degree at least 4; maximizing alkane size is equivalent to maximizing |S| under selected-degree <= 4, and the answer is 3|S| + 2.
Implement the internal-set reduction DP as described, including iterative traversal, top-four child aggregation, and final answer computation.

Validate on samples and edge cases: no degree>=4 vertex, single high-degree star, high-degree star with more than four high-degree neighbors, chain of high-degree vertices, N < 5, and large-path/large-star performance.
